title: Extraction Square
core_verb: Aim and shoot hostiles from behind the shoulder to clear the square, then reach extraction.
fantasy: An armed agent clears a village square of hostiles and escapes to extraction.
fail_state: Your health reaches zero from enemy attacks.
win_state: Clear every hostile in the square, then reach the extraction point.

interaction_tags.meaning: Enemy that pursues and shoots the player; contact and bullets remove health.
Collectible that refills the scarce ammo pool the player spends to fire.
Goal location, reachable only after every hostile is cleared; reaching it wins.

notes: The full campaign is reduced to one arena with a finite hostile group and an extraction exit: clear, then extract. AimResolver, ProjectileWeaponSystem and CombatBehaviorDirector cover the shooting; ammo scarcity is a spend pool, and loss is health zero.

scene.description: A dusty village square ringed by low houses, abandoned carts and stacked crates, hostiles between the player and a fenced extraction gate. Ammo pickups glow green in doorways, dry leaves and broken shutters clutter the edges. Dense cover, with the fight pushed across the square.
